delivery_events_payload_check.name: delivery_events_payload_check
delivery_events_payload_check.value:
(
        "delivery_events"."event_type" = 'delivered'
        and "delivery_events"."method" is not null
        and "delivery_events"."reverses_delivery_event_id" is null
        and "delivery_events"."correction_reason" is null
        and "delivery_events"."balance_at_delivery" is not null
        and "delivery_events"."balance_at_delivery" >= 0
        and (
          "delivery_events"."balance_at_delivery" <= 0
          or (
            "delivery_events"."agreement_terms" is not null
            and length(btrim("delivery_events"."agreement_terms")) > 0
          )
        )
      ) or (
        "delivery_events"."event_type" = 'reversed'
        and "delivery_events"."method" is null
        and "delivery_events"."reverses_delivery_event_id" is not null
        and "delivery_events"."correction_reason" is not null
        and length(btrim("delivery_events"."correction_reason")) > 0
      )

garments_block_state_check.name: garments_block_state_check
garments_block_state_check.value: ("garments"."blocked_at" is null and "garments"."blocking_reason" is null) or ("garments"."blocked_at" is not null and length(btrim("garments"."blocking_reason")) > 0)

garments_cancellation_state_check.name: garments_cancellation_state_check
garments_cancellation_state_check.value: ("garments"."cancelled_at" is null and "garments"."cancellation_reason" is null) or ("garments"."cancelled_at" is not null and length(btrim("garments"."cancellation_reason")) > 0)

garments_terminal_stage_check.name: garments_terminal_stage_check
garments_terminal_stage_check.value: ("garments"."stage" = 'cancelled' and "garments"."cancelled_at" is not null) or ("garments"."stage" <> 'cancelled' and "garments"."cancelled_at" is null)
